messages:
Alex Chen: quick pulse — SDKs / quickstarts / sampleapp dry-run
what I did: updated the node quickstart to use the new auth header layout, added an explicit example for streaming with `stream: true`, and pushed a small types doc tweak (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412).
blockers: sampleapp smoke fails on macos CI after the auth change — can't repro locally. failing step in e2e: `yarn test:sample --env=mac`
error snippet I see in CI:```
Error: 401 Unauthorized
 at /home/runner/sampleapp/src/lib/client.js:42:15
 at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```
can someone with mac CI access or osx box try a dry-run w/ `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY` set? unsure if this is a token formatting issue or a header normalization in our fetch wrapper.

Priya Nair: I can take this first pass. I'll run the mac job and post logs. my hunch is header casing — we recently normalized `x-rdwd-auth` -> `x-rdwd-authorization`.
I also glanced at the PR, small nit: the streaming example needs the `.on('data')` snippet (I'll add).
ETA: 45–60m.

Samir Patel: I ran a local mac vm and hit the same 401 earlier. quick check: try setting the env var both as `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY` and `RDWD_API_KEY` — our legacy wrapper still checks the latter for local dev.
Also, run this to reproduce locally:```bash
RDWD_API_KEY=localtest yarn start:sample:mac
# then in another terminal
yarn test:sample --watch
```
If it reproduces, it's definitely the wrapper. happy to pair if you want.

Taylor Gomez: tagged in case this is related to the last infra deploy — we swapped the ingress proxy last week, might have altered header passthrough rules. @eng-infra FYI.
No blockers from me on the docs side — once the smoke passes I'll merge the PR.

docs-bot: automated note: docs build job for PR #412 queued (docs-ci/quickstarts-matrix). Will report back with artifacts when complete. :robot_face:

Alex Chen: thanks — Samir if you can confirm the reproduce steps that narrows it. Priya, if mac job logs show header getting dropped, ping me and I'll open an infra ticket.
For the docs PR I attached a short screenshots gif of the streaming example to the PR — might help reviewers.
I'll also add a small test in the sampleapp that asserts the auth header is present on the first request so CI fails fast.

Priya Nair: update — ran the mac job, log shows header present but normalized to `authorization` (lowercase) by the proxy. sampleapp client does a strict `req.headers['x-rdwd-authorization']` check so it misses it.
Simple patch: check both `authorization` and `x-rdwd-authorization` in the client. I'll open a tiny PR to sampleapp.

Samir Patel: that matches my local repro. quick patch LGTM, adding a test to assert header lives in `req.headers` regardless of casing.

Alex Chen: perfect — if you both push the fixes I'll rerun the docs CI after sampleapp tests pass. thanks y'all. :tada:

Taylor Gomez: once merged, can someone also add a brief note in the runbook (internal) about the proxy header normalization so future quickstarts mention it? small line under "Auth quirks" should do it.

Priya Nair: noted — will add a two-sentence runbook entry and link it in the PR.

docs-bot: docs artifact for PR #412 available: https://ci.redwood-inference/docs/412/artifacts — preview up at https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.dev/quickstarts/node-streaming

Alex Chen: that's it from me. follow-ups: (1) sampleapp PR from Priya (2) unit test + CI run from Samir (3) runbook note from Priya (4) I will re-trigger docs job after merges.
If anyone wants to pair on the sampleapp test, ping me — I'm around until 5:30pm PST. :coffee:
